headline: Committee recommends council adopt resolution on lawsuit settlements and special counsel bills

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.voteItem: Close oral testimony on the agenda item
meeting.summary: The committee voted 6–0 to recommend the full council adopt a resolution sending all settlement offers to the council and having Council Services attorneys review special counsel's bills. It moves to the full council; the next meeting covers an auditors' fraud risk report.
meeting.recap: The chair said the meeting would give an update on a lawsuit against the County and sort out conflicts of interest.[[0:03:57]] The County's special counsel, an outside lawyer, said the lawsuit has been filed and the County will submit its answer this week.[[0:06:48]] One public testifier said the council must approve settlements.[[0:13:34]] The committee asked the state Attorney General's Office to send someone to the meeting but got no response.[[0:28:40]] The chair said the resolution would send all settlement offers to the council and have Council Services attorneys review special counsel's bills.[[0:42:39]] Special counsel said the County's answer to the lawsuit is due on the 25th.[[0:44:03]] The committee voted 7–0 to go into executive session, a closed-door meeting with its lawyers.[[0:58:09]] A council staff attorney confirmed the resolution is approved as to form and legality.[[1:04:27]] The committee voted 6–0 to recommend that the full council adopt the resolution.[[1:20:35]] The chair said the next committee meeting will cover an auditors' fraud risk report.[[1:21:33]]
decided: Oral testimony on the lawsuit item was closed with no objections.
The committee voted to go into executive session to consult with its legal counsel.
The committee voted to recommend that the full council adopt the resolution.
meeting.next: Special counsel said the next step in the lawsuit is a meeting with the judge to set dates, and both sides will share information. The resolution will move on to the full council for consideration. The next scheduled committee meeting will cover the auditors' fraud risk and fraud, waste and abuse assessment report. The committee will take up good governance reform bills being worked on with the Board of Ethics after the fraud report meeting.
